explanation: The value is 0 everywhere except at D1 in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 93 to 99) when the previous trial was unrewarded: the first unrewarded D1 after a rewarded trial gives 8 to 10 (about 6 to 7 at trial 99), and a second unrewarded D1 in a row drops to about 3 to 4, then 0 to 2 after that. Every GO and D2 step is 0, every rewarded D1 is 0, and every step before about trial 92 is 0, whatever the choices or transitions.
